data.Ping An Scheme: Comprehensive Medical Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China underwritten by Ping An Annuity.
data.lxbx.net: Official service and claim verification platform for international students in China.
data.Fapiao: Official computerized tax/medical invoice (医疗收费票据/电子票据) required for all medical reimbursement in China.
data.Public Tertiary Hospital: Class 3A or designated public hospital (二级及以上公立医院) standard outpatient and inpatient departments.
data.Outpatient Deductible: Standard threshold (typically RMB 650) above which reasonable outpatient medical fees are reimbursed at coinsurance rate.
data.Residence Permit: Foreigner residence permit for study (居留许可 - 学习) issued by PRC Exit-Entry Administration.
